# Five whys

Prose mentioning nothing.

# Mechanisms

1. Live one: a script exists — ⚙ dotfiles exists-art.sh :1-9 — owner aide — state LIVE.
2. Missing one: script never installed — ⚙ dotfiles missing-art.sh — owner aide — state SPEC.
3. No artifact named here — owner r7 — state SPEC.
4. Merged but never installed — ⚙ dotfiles PR #164 merged — owner rb — state LIVE.
5. Remote host timer — ⚙ rb exists-art.timer — owner rb — state LIVE.
